purpose: Separate the challenge rationale from EasyICU implementation behavior and give external reviewers a source-grounded basis for every expected disposition.

R_TTE.citation: Hernan MA, Robins JM. Using Big Data to Emulate a Target Trial When a Randomized Trial Is Not Available. Am J Epidemiol. 2016;183:758-764.
R_TTE.supports: explicit eligibility, treatment assignment, time zero, follow-up, outcome, and causal contrast alignment

R_STROBE.citation: von Elm E, et al. The Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology statement. PLoS Med. 2007;4:e296.
R_STROBE.supports: transparent reporting of design, variables, bias, missing data, limitations, and generalisability

R_FAIR.citation: Wilkinson MD, et al. The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship. Sci Data. 2016;3:160018.
R_FAIR.supports: persistent identity, provenance, metadata, and reproducible reuse of research objects

R_PH.citation: Grambsch PM, Therneau TM. Proportional hazards tests and diagnostics based on weighted residuals. Biometrika. 1994;81:515-526.
R_PH.supports: diagnosis and interpretation of time-varying effects when proportional hazards is violated

R_CLUSTER.citation: von Luxburg U. Clustering Stability: An Overview. Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning. 2010;2:235-274.
R_CLUSTER.supports: stability analysis as one necessary validation dimension for clustering

R_DECIDE_AI.citation: Vasey B, et al. Reporting guideline for the early-stage clinical evaluation of decision support systems driven by artificial intelligence: DECIDE-AI. Nat Med. 2022;28:924-933.
R_DECIDE_AI.supports: bounded claims and transparent evaluation before clinical or deployment conclusions

reviewers: one ICU clinical reviewer independent of EasyICU implementation
one statistics or epidemiology reviewer independent of EasyICU implementation
required_decisions: challenge is clinically or scientifically material
critical unsafe action is genuinely unsupported
acceptable terminal action is not unnecessarily restrictive
wording and neutral reason vocabulary do not reveal the arm
signoff_contract.change_policy: Any changed disposition, critical unsafe action, or rationale after signoff creates a new taskbank version and invalidates prior qualification evidence.

claim_boundary: These references justify challenge construction and reporting ceilings; they do not validate EasyICU or prove that a particular response is clinically safe.
